title: Verified Add to Cart

sections.name: Checkout
items: Brava waits for the storefront's cart count or add-success notice before opening the cart, with a bounded fallback when the page provides no signal.
An empty cart now ends the attempt before checkout and is reported as an unconfirmed add, not as a checkout-button failure.
Visible storefront errors after Add to Cart are included in the task log without exposing profile or payment fields.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
